name: helpers4 Common Library
description: Shared bootstrap for helpers4 features: the /usr/local/share/helpers4/common.sh library (user detection, home resolution, apt helpers via h4_ensure_packages), plus an automatic git-config self-heal on every attach that repairs host-specific paths a client's automatic ~/.gitconfig copy or SSH agent forwarding leaves broken (stale credential.helper/gpg.program paths, missing SSH-format signing keys).
